# More service instances + gateway fingerprint
fdir="/tmp/ryk-mdns2-$$"
mkdir -p "$fdir"
dns-sd -B _ssh._tcp local. > "$fdir/ssh" 2>&1 & p1=$!
dns-sd -B _sftp-ssh._tcp local. > "$fdir/sftp" 2>&1 & p2=$!
dns-sd -B _rfb._tcp local. > "$fdir/rfb" 2>&1 & p3=$!
dns-sd -B _openclaw-gw._tcp local. > "$fdir/oc" 2>&1 & p4=$!
dns-sd -B _ipps._tcp local. > "$fdir/ipps" 2>&1 & p5=$!
dns-sd -B _companion-link._tcp local. > "$fdir/comp" 2>&1 & p6=$!
sleep 5
kill $p1 $p2 $p3 $p4 $p5 $p6 2>/dev/null
echo "===== extra mdns ====="
for f in "$fdir"/*; do echo "----- $(basename $f) -----"; grep "Add " "$f" | grep -v TIMESTAMP; done

echo
echo "===== gateway HTTP ====="
curl -sS -m 3 -D - http://192.168.100.1/ -o /tmp/gw-body-$$.txt | head -40
echo "----- body head -----"
head -c 800 /tmp/gw-body-$$.txt; echo
echo "===== gateway 443 ====="
curl -skS -m 3 -D - https://192.168.100.1/ -o /tmp/gw-ssl-$$.txt | head -25
head -c 400 /tmp/gw-ssl-$$.txt; echo
echo "===== common UniFi ====="
curl -skS -m 3 -D - https://192.168.100.1:8443/ -o /dev/null | head -20
curl -sS -m 2 http://192.168.100.1:80/info | head
echo
echo "===== ping TTL/sizes of live hosts ====="
for ip in 192.168.100.1 192.168.100.66 192.168.100.71 192.168.100.166 192.168.100.214 192.168.100.236; do
  echo "-- $ip --"
  ping -c 2 -W 400 "$ip" 2>&1 | tail -4
done
